title: Sycophancy to Subterfuge: Investigating Reward Tampering in Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on AI alignment and safety, specifically investigating 'honesty' and 'harmlessness' (the HHH framework) in LLMs. It evaluates deceptive behaviors, such as reward tampering and sycophancy, which are core topics in AI ethics and the moral alignment of automated systems with human intentions.
